reasoning_summary: The deterministic verdict for R0 is INCONCLUSIVE with no failed checks. I can't ACCEPT, and there is no measured FAIL to justify REJECT.

R0's averaging and statistics components pass. Drag CI95 is 5.8838e-06 and the Strouhal statistics uncertainty is 1.621e-05, both far below the 0.03 tolerance. R0 has 14 stationary cycles and a drag drift of 1.1249e-05.
Mesh, time and domain uncertainty are all unmeasured for both quantities, so combined_uncertainty is null.

The domain is the most likely source of an error larger than 3%. The recorded blockage ratio is 0.125 (half_height_D 4.0 with symmetryPlane lateral boundaries), the inlet is 8D upstream and the outlet 15D downstream. The question asks for an unbounded stream. Confinement of this size can shift both mean drag (R0: 1.5089) and Strouhal number (R0: 0.17963) by more than the tolerance.

Temporal resolution looks adequate: max Courant is 0.74419, with 556.7 steps per shedding period and a second-order backward scheme. The mesh has 160 cells around the cylinder and a wall-first-cell height of 0.005 D, so it is likely fine near the body. Both are less likely to exceed 3% than the domain truncation.

EXPAND_DOMAIN is the cheapest experiment (397 s against 545 s for REDUCE_TIME_STEP and 640 s for REFINE_MESH). It leaves the near-field mesh unchanged, so it isolates the boundary effect. Budget is untouched: 0 of 6 experiments used.
Mesh and time experiments will still be needed afterwards, because the verifier requires every component to be measured.

Confirmation that the MSER-capped stationary window start (70.199, flagged as a cap) does not hide a residual transient. The recorded drift and half-difference values are tiny, so this is a minor concern.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The 12.5% blockage and the 4D symmetry-plane lateral boundaries, together with the 8D inlet and 15D outlet distances, bias mean Cd and St by more than 3% relative to an unbounded stream.
hypotheses.test: EXPAND_DOMAIN with factor 2.0 from R0. If the relative change in Cd or St exceeds about 3% (beyond noise), the root is invalid for the unbounded question, which is a FAIL. If both changes are well below 1.5%, the domain component passes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mesh and time-step errors are each within 1.5% (half tolerance).
hypotheses.test: Follow-up REFINE_MESH (about 1.4142) and REDUCE_TIME_STEP (factor 2) runs, each compared against R0 or the best-domain run.

next_experiment.reason: Blockage ratio 0.125 with symmetryPlane lateral walls at 4D, 8D upstream and 15D downstream is the largest plausible bias for an unbounded-stream request. This is the cheapest primitive (397 s), and it leaves the near-field mesh and time step unchanged, so any change in Cd or St is attributable to the boundaries.
next_experiment.expected_outcome: With half height 8D and blockage 0.0625, a Cd or St change greater than 3% would show the root is domain-biased (FAIL). A change below about 1.5% would let the domain component pass and leave mesh and time as the remaining unknowns.
